headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for the **[SMLIGHT SLWF-01Pro](https://smartlight.me/smart-home-devices/wifi-devices/wifi-dongle-air-conditioners-midea-idea-electrolux-for-home-assistant)** Wi-Fi AC dongle. Supports mDNS auto-discovery on the local network and multi-entity bundling (humidity / outdoor temperature / power sensors, Beeper / Display switches, DRY / FAN_ONLY mode tiles).
footerDisplay: Maintained by [@nookied](https://github.com/nookied/homebridge-SLWF-01Pro). Speaks the [ESPHome native API](https://esphome.io/components/api.html), so any ESPHome Climate device on the local network is also supported.

debug.title: Enable Debug Logs
debug.description: Surface device state-change chatter to the main log (otherwise sent to log.debug).

autoDiscover.title: Auto-discover SLWF-01Pro devices via mDNS
autoDiscover.description: Browses the local network for ESPHome `_esphomelib._tcp` services and adds any device that exposes a Climate entity. Only works for unencrypted devices. Manually configured devices in the list below take precedence and are required for any device with the ESPHome API encryption key set.

disableHumiditySensor.title: Hide Humidity sensor service (for ACs without a real humidity probe)

port.title: Native API port
port.description: ESPHome's native API port. Default 6053; rarely needs changing.

encryptionKey.title: API encryption key (base64)
encryptionKey.description: If your device's ESPHome YAML has `api.encryption.key:` set, paste the same base64 key here. Leave empty if encryption isn't enabled.

disableHumiditySensor.title: Hide Humidity sensor for this device

disableOutdoorTempSensor.title: Hide Outdoor Temperature for this device

disablePowerSensor.title: Hide Power Usage for this device

disableBeeperSwitch.title: Hide Beeper switch for this device

disableDisplaySwitch.title: Hide Display Toggle for this device

disableDryMode.title: Hide DRY mode switch for this device

disableFanOnlyMode.title: Hide FAN_ONLY mode switch for this device

layout.title: Global service toggles (apply to all devices)
Manual device list
layout.description: Optional. Required for any device with the ESPHome API encryption key set (mDNS doesn't broadcast it, so auto-discovery alone won't work for those). Per-device toggles override the globals.
